sources.entry: Quickwords - Write anything in a matter of seconds. Create snippets that can substitute text, execute tedious tasks and more.

summary.one_liner: Quickwords is a macOS text-snippet app that expands short keystrokes into common words, phrases, and paragraphs, though its authors have abandoned development.
summary.what_it_does: Quickwords is a productivity app meant to let you substitute common words, phrases, and paragraphs with a few keystrokes. It works by registering global keyboard events, so it can see everything typed on the system. The README says only the last 20 keystrokes are kept in app memory and no data is saved to disk. The README describes it as available on macOS, with installation by downloading a release, unzipping it, and dragging Quickwords.app into Applications. Linux and Windows versions are described only as "coming soon," with PRs welcome in the meantime. The README also covers a security-vulnerability contact and an FAQ about accessibility permissions needed for replacements to work.
use_cases: expand text snippets with keyboard shortcuts
substitute frequently typed phrases or paragraphs
speed up repetitive typing on macOS
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page
Drag Quickwords.app into your Applications folder
Grant accessibility access in System Preferences so replacements work
notable: Global keyboard event handling for text substitution across apps
Keeps only the last 20 keystrokes in memory and states no data is saved to disk
Authors have since moved on to Dilato, a closed-source clinician app
caveats: Authors have abandoned the project; README discourages use because it has not received security updates for a long time
macOS only; Linux and Windows versions are not available
Requires macOS accessibility permission, and some older macOS versions may need restarts to work
